title: Personal training and strength
description: Qualified trainer; portable equipment or a verified home gym. No clinical treatment claims.

title: Pilates and barre
description: Mat and portable props travel easily. Reformer instruction needs approved existing equipment or a separately agreed studio partner.

title: Yoga and private practice
description: Teacher, style, mats, props and participant compatibility agreed. Styles are variants of a useful family page.

title: Mobility, stretching and ergonomics
description: General movement and workstation coaching. Treatment of pain or injury belongs with the clinical pathway.

title: Boxing, dance and movement skills
description: Non-contact fitness, suitable flooring and clearance. Children need a separate safeguarding and competence gate.

title: Swimming and sport conditioning
description: Pool, property access and rescue competence checked. Route sessions begin at the property; specialist sports skills may need a different venue.

title: Massage and bodywork
description: Bring table, clean linens and agreed products. Touch, draping, privacy and pressure consent are part of delivery.

title: Recovery sessions and equipment
description: Device use, suitability and installation are checked separately. Equipment rental quotes need period, setup, maintenance and collection.

title: Mindfulness, sleep routines and relaxation
description: Separate ordinary coaching from clinical mental healthcare. Sound and Reiki are described as experiences without healing promises.

title: Nutrition, cooking and food routines
description: Nutrition scope and secure intake checked. Chef work uses the existing myCHEF operation and its current written quote.

title: Women's life stages and postpartum support
description: Specialist competence is required for pregnancy and postnatal work. Lactation and clinical concerns use an appropriate partner pathway.

title: Children, families, older adults and adaptive fitness
description: Separate qualifications, consent, guardian presence and accessibility checks. General fitness is distinct from clinical rehabilitation or care.

title: Beauty, grooming and private spa
description: A qualified mobile beauty partner, hygienic tools and realistic setup requirements. Restrict initial scope to non-invasive services.

title: Clinical and specialist partner services
description: Partner pathway only until professional permissions, home visit scope, contracting, insurance, consent and restricted records are verified.

title: Villa groups, workplaces and programmes
description: These are packages or delivery formats of the underlying services. They are not ten new professions or ten automatic landing pages.
